final: SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count, AVG(record_count - average_count) AS average_difference FROM (SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM film_actor fa JOIN film f ON f.film_id = fa.film_id GROUP BY rating HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(group_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM film_actor fa2 JOIN film f2 ON f2.film_id = fa2.film_id GROUP BY f2.rating) counts)) kept JOIN (SELECT AVG(group_count) AS average_count FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM film_actor fa3 JOIN film f3 ON f3.film_id = fa3.film_id GROUP BY f3.rating)) average_values ON 1=1
